title: Table with Dittos

illustrates.quote: Dittos. The ditto mark (dots 5, 2) is left-adjusted in the appropriate column. (See UEB, §3.12, Ditto mark.) ... (See Sample 11-12: Table with Dittos on page 11-37.)

print.caption: Table 4-3 / PRICE AND QUANTITY OF MILK
print.notes: Print uses the typographic ditto mark (”) to repeat "Surplus"/"Fall" for 0.90/0.80 and "Shortage"/"Rise" for 0.50/0.40.
print.printFeatures: No box border (unboxed table). "Table 4-3" (bold) and "PRICE AND QUANTITY OF MILK" (small capitals) stand at the top left with a ruled line beneath them; header row ("Price", "Surplus/ Shortage", "Price Will") with a ruled line beneath it; no vertical rules and no rules between data rows; dittos (") in the Surplus/Shortage and Price Will columns.

braille.notes: Title "Table 4-3" plus page-continuation-type marker '#bac' appears on line 1 (right-justified), "PRICE AND QUANTITY OF MILK" (triple-cap quoted) on line 2. Each ditto ('"') in print becomes the braille ditto mark (shaded grey in the PDF sample image, dots 5,2) left-adjusted in its column, on lines 7-8 (under Surplus/Fall) and lines 11-12 (under Shortage/Rise), per rule 11.6.6. No transcriber's note explaining the ditto mark is included within the excerpted lines shown (rule 11.6.6.b requires it be listed on the Special Symbols page or in a transcriber's note, not necessarily inline before this particular table).

uncertain: Whether a transcriber's note or Special-Symbols-page listing for the ditto mark appears elsewhere on this braille page (outside the 13 lines captured for this sample) could not be confirmed from the excerpt alone.

The print ditto mark is transcribed here as a plain ASCII double quote ('"') rather than a typeset right-double-quotation-mark glyph; print ditto marks are conventionally straight tick/prime marks, but the exact Unicode code point was not independently confirmed against the raster image.
resolution: print.rows: the print ditto mark is recorded as a plain ASCII double quote to match the braille's own guide-dot-style rendering, not a typeset right-double-quotation-mark glyph (see uncertain notes). Print description corrected 23 Sep 2026 (see printCorrections).

printCorrections.was: Bordered box (title outside/above); no visible ruled separation lines between data rows in this excerpt; header row bold.
printCorrections.now: No box border (unboxed table). "Table 4-3" (bold) and "PRICE AND QUANTITY OF MILK" (small capitals) stand at the top left with a ruled line beneath them; header row ("Price", "Surplus/ Shortage", "Price Will") with a ruled line beneath it; no vertical rules and no rules between data rows; dittos (") in the Surplus/Shortage and Price Will columns.
printCorrections.evidence: references/bana/braille-formats-2016.pdf p.319 (rendered at 200 dpi, cropped): there is no outer border and no vertical rules; the only rules are one under the title and one under the header row. The old text said "Bordered box (title outside/above)". The builder reads "no box"/"unboxed" in printFeatures (gold-run.mjs noBox), so the table is now built unboxed as the braille shows.
